milestone_full: Layer S continues: 179 Hong Kong chapters in three arms, atlas lockstep 178/178/178 with a derived fence. World Answer gained a full-read tier (40 chunks x 4,000 chars - the retrieval contract's own clamps - toward the 50k-token context goal). The stack was siege-tested at PRODUCTION rate limits: a 2,702-request credential-stuffing flood met the auth bucket - ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx, the unscoped read plane stayed 244/244 OK at p50=8 ms THROUGHOUT the flood. Two real optimizations landed: FactBundle's lazy attribute index (~120 linear scans per search removed) and ranking weights cached by mtime (YAML re-parse per request gone): per-request Python CPU ~107 ms -> ~30 ms. The en dictionary's Han characters are a measured 19-leaf allowlist (Cantonese teaching pool + cited names), enforced by contract test. verify_all NO OFFENDER (PASS 73), 76 readers reachable, web vitest 974/974.
headline: 179 chapters · full-read tier (up to 160k chars of real body) · siege-tested: 2,702-request stuffing flood ALL 429 at p50=25ms, zero 5xx, read plane 244/244 · 76 readers green.
features: D1541: siege re-measured at production limits - 10 grants then the 429 wall; stuffing 2,702 ALL 429; read plane 244/244 throughout.
D1540: World Answer full-read tier (40x4000, the retrieval contract's own clamps) toward the 50k-token context goal; three-tier whitelist end-to-end.
D1538: FactBundle lazy attribute index + ranking-weights mtime cache - per-request Python CPU ~107ms -> ~30ms, measured by in-process profile with the lifespan actually run.
D1539: story-recap default-window fixture made window-agnostic; the en arm's no-Han promise enforced with a measured 19-leaf allowlist.
D1537: pressure probe grew a siege leg (four populations, one clock) after the capacity statement was found measured against an orphan server on port 8010.
privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S 持續：179 章香港系列三語臂，圖譜鎖步 178/178/178、圍欄數字由索引推導。跨章問答新增全讀檔（40 章 × 4,000 字——檢索契約自身上限，向 5 萬 token 上下文目標推進）。以生產級限流實測攻城：2,702 發撞庫全部撞上 429 牆（p50=25ms、零 5xx），無範圍限制的讀面在攻擊全程 244/244 全綠（p50=8ms）。兩項真實優化落地：FactBundle 惰性屬性索引（移除每輪搜尋約 120 次全量線性掃描）、排序權重 mtime 緩存（每請求 YAML 重析消失）：每請求 Python CPU 約 107ms → 約 30ms。en 字典漢字為有測量的 19 條白名單（粵語教學池＋引用專名），契約測試強制。verify_all 全綠（PASS 73）、76 個讀器可達、web vitest 974/974。
